name: spaces_patch_node
description: Patch nodes. ~10 per call is the sweet spot; 20 is the hard maximum. Each item: nodeId + partial patch; send only the fields you change, the rest keeps its value. Cannot touch id, type, workflowConnections or run state. @see guides_get('spaces')

pageId.description: The node must belong to this page. To move a node, set patch.pageId instead.

patch.description: Allowed fields: data (object; prompt goes in data.prompt), pageId/page target page, x, y, locked, visible, panelIndex, name, headerVisible, layout. Use layout.groupId for panel membership; a panel may go inside another panel only for accounts with nested groups enabled (up to 6 levels, root panel included), otherwise that patch fails saying nested groups are not enabled for this user. To move a node set layout.relativeToNodeId plus direction (left/right/above/below), optional alignment (start/center/end, default start), and optional inheritPanel (default true). x/y are a preferred spot only (the board moves the node on collision, see relocated[]); width/height are ignored — size follows node type — except on panel (200x150 to 20000) and sticky-note (216 to 5000), which take the size given. A panel is refit around its members whenever they change, which overrides a size given in the same call. To rename a group/panel node set data.name (top-level name is mirrored to it for panels). List: data.items replaces the whole list; send every item to keep. Branded image-generator: data.prompt = short topic + user constraints only, never the template name (brandKitTemplateSlug + chip carry it); data.mode = magnific-one (Brand Kit only works with it; a run with another model is switched to it). Do not run until that prompt is non-empty.
